newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to slither towards 100.90 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to slither towards 100.90 support.

text.p: LIFFE September Bund futures will move sideways on Tuesday but a test of crucial support at 100.90 is likely, chart analysts said.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said a small trendline on the 30-minute chart provided immediate support at 101.10.
"What we're looking for is a test of the trendline at 101.10, a bounce up to fill the gap on the topside at 101.27 and to get down towards 100.90," she said.
100.90 was around the June 19 and 20 lows and a 38.2 percent retracement of the rally from 99.32 to 101.88.
By 0710 GMT, September Bunds were quoted 0.07 down at 101.21.
Miller said if the contract broke through 100.90 this week it should head towards 100.30 which is a 61.8 percent retracement of the same rally and a major trendline on the weekly continuation charts.
"If we break that it's going to be very significant," she said. "But that would be our favourite play."
On the upside, Miller saw initial resistance at Tuesday's high of 101.29 followed by 101.51, which is the 61.8 percent retracement of the the decline from mid-June highs.
Further up, the risk for bears was a test of 101.83, a key trendline resistance on the weekly continuation chart.
A break of 101.83 would also negate a head-and-shoulders formation, again on weekly continuation charts, with the head being at the mid-February level of 104.04 , Miller said.
Technical analysts at Chase said the bullish outlook for Bunds was intact after the market stayed above 101.05 on Monday.
But a corrective setback should be expected, putting 100.94 under pressure.
"A move below this level suggests a test of 100.71/65 from where it should bounce," Chase said in note.
September Euromark futures were unchanged at 96.82.
